feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 30 June 2026 6:10pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 30 June 2026 at 6:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds tomorrow.


##Synopsis##

Shallow area of low pressure over Scotland gradually clearing as a ridge of high pressure approaches from the west.


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, veering west or southwest 2 to 4 this evening, then northwest 3 to 5 tonight. Backing west 2 to 4 by midday tomorrow, then increasing south or southwest 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon, increasing 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight becoming slight or moderate later tomorrow.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, occasionally rain later tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor later tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 to 6, soon increasing south or southwest 5 to 7 early evening tomorrow, veering west or northwest 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate soon becoming mainly moderate and occasionally rough later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle becoming fair overnight into Thursday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
